statements:
CREATE TABLE map_operation (
        operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        action TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        rollback_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL,
        relocalized INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE map_operation_phase (
        operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
        phase TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (operation_id, seq),
        FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES map_operation (operation_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE map_task_link (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        definition TEXT NOT NULL,
        map_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        invalidated INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE map_home_link (
        robot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        source_robot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        map_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        waypoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        adopted INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE waypoint (
        waypoint_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        robot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        x REAL NOT NULL,
        y REAL NOT NULL,
        yaw REAL NOT NULL,
        map_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        anchor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_robot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        latitude REAL,
        longitude REAL,
        anchor_x REAL NOT NULL,
        anchor_y REAL NOT NULL,
        anchor_yaw REAL NOT NULL,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX waypoint_one_home
    ON waypoint (robot_id)
    WHERE kind = 'home'

CREATE TABLE task_definition (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        robot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        map_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        waypoint_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
        schedule_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        every_seconds INTEGER,
        cron_expression TEXT,
        timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE task_execution (
        execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        occurrence_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        navigation_sent INTEGER NOT NULL,
        rollback_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE (task_id, occurrence_utc),
        FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES task_definition (task_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE task_skip (
        skip_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        skip_from TEXT NOT NULL,
        skip_until TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES task_definition (task_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE task_runtime (
        robot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        boot_id TEXT NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE cloud_session (
        token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        csrf_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        expires_at REAL NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE cloud_pairing_code (
        code_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
        redeemed_at REAL
    )

CREATE TABLE cloud_robot (
        robot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        device_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        created_at REAL NOT NULL,
        revoked_at REAL
    )
ALTER TABLE cloud_robot ADD COLUMN connection_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
